source_name: titanic3 (Thomas Cason, from Encyclopedia Titanica, state of 2 August 1999)
terms: https://hbiostat.org/data/ - 'Permission is granted to anyone wishing to use the data sets provided here.'
required_credit: Data obtained from http://hbiostat.org/data courtesy of the Vanderbilt University Department of Biostatistics.
upstream_note: Built from Encyclopedia Titanica, whose own content is not necessarily public domain; this repository therefore commits no names or biographical text.
coverage: Passengers only (crew excluded); not the complete ship's company
split_method: StratifiedGroupKFold; first outer fold held out
grouping: Shared ticket strings, replaced by invented group identifiers
repeated_cv: 20 repeats x 5 StratifiedGroupKFold folds over all rows; seeds 20261114..20261133

derived_columns.TicketSize: Rows in titanic3 sharing the ticket string
derived_columns.FarePerPerson: Fare / TicketSize (Fare is recorded per ticket, not per person)
derived_columns.Title: Mr / Mrs (incl. Mme) / Miss (incl. Mlle, Ms) / Master / Rare; name discarded
derived_columns.BoatSide: Recorded boat mapped to Starboard (odd, A, C) or Port (even, B, D); descriptive only, never a predictor
derived_columns.InKaggleTrain: 1 if the passenger is in the 891-row Kaggle training sample
